jobs.title: Network Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Was du über uns wissen solltest Die Emil Frey Gruppe ist nicht nur ein Schweizer Familienunternehmen mit 100 Jahren Erfahrung, sondern auch eine der führenden Firmen der Automobilbranche. Qualität, Tradition, Innovation und Kundenorientierung sind die tragenden Pfeiler des Unternehmens. Dabei liegt der Fokus der Aktivitäten auf dem Import von Automarken, dem Betrieb von Garagen, der Logistik von Ersatz- und Zubehörteilen sowie der Erbringung von Finanzdienstleistungen. Die Emil Frey IT Solutions AG erbringt für die Emil Frey Gruppe verschiedene, zentrale ICT-Dienstleistungen und verwaltet die Server-Backend Systeme in zwei Datacenters zusammen mit der Hybrid-Cloud Infrastruktur für ca. 10'000 User, welche an über 100 Standorten in Europa arbeiten. Für die IT-Infrastructure-Abteilung am Standort Zürich-Altstetten oder Safenwil, suchen wir eine/n Network Security Engineer Welche Aufgaben wirst du übernehmen
• Sicherstellung des stabilen und sicheren Betriebs der zentralen Firewall-Infrastruktur im Rechenzentrum
• Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der zentralen Firewall-Infrastruktur
• Bearbeitung von Störungen im 2nd- und 3rd-Level-Support
• Erstellung technischer Konzepte, Systemübersichten sowie umfassender Dokumentationen
• Planung und Durchführen von Umstellungen und Systemwartungen Was du mitbringst
• Fachausbildung in Informatik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Betrieb von Firewall und Security-Plattformen, vorzugsweise von Fortinet
• Erfahrung mit Sicherheitslösungen (Cisco ISE, NAC, Web-Proxy) sind von Vorteil
• Kenntnisse in Skriptsprachen wie Python sind von Vorteil
• Selbstständige Arbeitsweise und Freude an teamübergreifender Zusammenarbeit
• Hohes Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsbewusstsein
• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse
• Bereitschaft zum Pikettdienst Was dich bei uns erwartet Du findest bei uns eine neue Herausforderung mit spannenden Aufgaben und vielem mehr:
• Zahlreiche Vergünstigungen (Neu- und Gebrauchtwagen, Servicearbeiten und Ersatzteile, Fahrzeug- und Krankenversicherungen, Tankkarten, Hotels und vieles mehr)
• Eine eigene, attraktive Pensionskasse als unabhängige Vorsorgeeinrichtung
• Eine langfristige Unternehmensperspektive
• Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungs-Möglichkeiten
• Mindestens 25 Tage Ferien Wie du uns kontaktieren kannst Wir freuend uns auf deine vollständige Bewerbung (u.a. Lebenslauf, Arbeitszeugnisse, etc.) via des Links "Jetzt bewerben!". Aus Gründen der besseren Lesbarkeit wird auf die gleichzeitige Verwendung der Sprachformen männlich, weiblich und divers (m/w/d) verzichtet. Weibliche und anderweitige Geschlechteridentitäten werden dabei ausdrücklich mitgemeint. Diversität bedeutet für uns auch, dass Menschen in Teams zusammenarbeiten, die durch ihre Einzigartigkeit und Unterschiedlichkeit die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse erzielen. Wir sind davon überzeugt, dass eine vielfältige Belegschaft, sowie eine integrative Kultur es uns ermöglichen, unser volles Potenzial auszuschöpfen.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Quello che dovresti sapere su di noi Il Gruppo Emil Frey non è solo un'azienda svizzera a conduzione familiare con 100 anni di esperienza, ma anche una delle aziende leader nel settore automobilistico. Qualità, tradizione, innovazione e attenzione al cliente sono i pilastri portanti dell'azienda. Le attività si concentrano sull'importazione di marchi automobilistici, sulla gestione di garage, sulla logistica di pezzi di ricambio e accessori e sulla fornitura di servizi finanziari. Emil Frey IT Solutions AG fornisce vari servizi ICT centralizzati per il gruppo Emil Frey e gestisce i sistemi di back-end del server in due data center insieme all'infrastruttura cloud ibrida per circa 10.000 utenti che lavorano in oltre 100 sedi in Europa. Per il reparto IT Infrastructure nella sede di Zurigo-Altstetten o Safenwil, siamo alla ricerca di un/a Network Security Engineer Quali compiti svolgerai
• Garantire il funzionamento stabile e sicuro dell'infrastruttura centrale del firewall nel data center
• Continuo sviluppo dell'infrastruttura centrale del firewall
• Gestione dei guasti nel supporto di 2° e 3° livello
• Creazione di concetti tecnici, panoramiche del sistema e documentazione completa
• Pianificazione ed esecuzione di conversioni e manutenzione del sistema Cosa porti
• Formazione specialistica in informatica o qualifica comparabile
• Esperienza pluriennale nel funzionamento di firewall e piattaforme di sicurezza,
descriptionByLocale.en:
What you should know about us The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family business with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation and customer orientation are the main pillars of the company. The focus of the activities is on the import of car brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare parts and accessories as well as the provision of financial services. Emil Frey IT Solutions AG provides various central ICT services for the Emil Frey Group and manages the server backend systems in two data centers together with the hybrid cloud infrastructure for approx. 10,000 users working at over 100 locations in Europe. For the IT infrastructure department at the Zurich-Altstetten or Safenwil location, we are looking for a Network Security Engineer What tasks will you take on
• Ensuring the stable and secure operation of the central firewall infrastructure in the data center
• Continuous further development of the central firewall infrastructure
• Processing of disruptions in 2nd and 3rd level support
• Creation of technical concepts, system overviews and comprehensive documentation
• Planning and implementation of conversions and system maintenance What you bring with you
• Specialist training in computer science or comparable qualifications
• Several years of experience in the operation of firewall and security platforms,

What you should know about us The Emil Frey Group is not only a family-owned Swiss company with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation and customer orientation are the main pillars of the company. The focus of the activities is on the import of car brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare parts and accessories as well as the provision of financial services. Emilley AG St. Gallen is an official sales and service partner of the Jaguar, Landrover, Toyota, Lexus, Suzuki, Mitsubishi, Subaru and Zeekr brands and also has a carrosserie and a spare part warehouse. Your tasks
• Performing service and repair work according to the manufacturer's specifications
• Checking the functionality of various components
• Diagnosis with the help of the workshop manager
• Regular participation in training courses and further trainings Your profile
• Completed vocational training as an automotive mechatronics engineer
• Continuing training or interest in continuing training as an automotive diagnostician
• You are self-employed, capable of teaming and have a quality awareness
• Good German knowledge in word and writing
• Guide ID Cat. B What we offer You will find a new challenge with exciting tasks and much more:
• Numerous discounts (new and used cars, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels and much more)
• A private, attractive pension fund as an independent pension institution
• A long-term company perspective
• Individual training and development opportunities
• At least 25 days of holidays How to contact us Daniela Bühler, Regional Personnel Manager, is looking forward to the complete Application (including CV, work certificates, etc.) via the link "Apply now!". For reasons of better readability, the simultaneous use of the language forms male, female and divers (m/w/d) is waived. Female and other gender identities are explicitly mentioned. For us, diversity also means that people in teams work together, who achieve the best possible results through their uniqueness and diversity. We are convinced that a diverse workforce, as well as an inclusive culture, will enable us to exploit our full potential.

## Emil Frey Gruppe La Emil Frey Gruppe non è solo un'azienda familiare svizzera con 100 anni di esperienza, ma anche una delle principali aziende del settore automobilistico. Qualità, tradizione, innovazione e orientamento al cliente sono i pilastri dell'azienda. Le attività si concentrano sull'importazione di marche automobilistiche, l'esercizio di garage, la logistica di parti di ricambio e accessori, nonché la fornitura di servizi finanziari. Con 19 marche mondiali sotto un unico tetto, l'Emil Frey AG Autocenter Safenwil dispone della più ampia gamma di marche nel centro della Svizzera. ### Descrizione - Diagnosi e riparazioni di sistemi elettronici, meccanici, idraulici e pneumatici del veicolo - Esecuzione di riparazioni, conversioni e sostituzioni complesse - Esecuzione di lavori di servizio e manutenzione - Preparazione di MFK - Fornitura tecnica di veicoli nuovi e di seconda mano - Inserimento di accessori - Formazione pratica per allievi di tecnica automobilistica ###
• Requisiti - Laurea conclusa con successo come meccanico automobilistico/mechatronico - Laurea in corso o già conclusa come diagnostico automobilistico - Lavoro autonomo e meticoloso - Approccio efficiente e strutturato - Personalità responsabile, team-oriented e comunicativa - Lingua madre tedesca o conoscenze tedesche molto buone in parole e scrittura ###
• Cosa offriamo - Troverai una nuova sfida con compiti interessanti e molto altro: - Numerose agevolazioni (veicoli nuovi e di seconda mano, lavori di servizio e parti di ricambio, assicurazioni di veicoli e malattia, carte di carburante, alberghi e molto altro) - Una propria, attraente cassa di pensione come ente di previdenza indipendente - Una prospettiva di impiego a lungo termine - Possibilità di formazione e sviluppo individuali - Almeno 25 giorni di ferie - Posto di parcheggio gratuito - Ristorante personale ### Contatto Melanie Achini, Responsabile locale del personale, si compiacerà della tua candidatura completa (ad esempio, curriculum, attestati di lavoro, ecc.) via il link "Candidati ora!". Per motivi di leggibilità, si è deciso di non utilizzare contemporaneamente le forme grammaticali maschile, femminile e diverso (m/w/d). Le identità di genere femminile e altre vengono esplicitamente incluse. La diversità significa che le persone lavorano in team che, grazie alla loro unicità e diversità, raggiungono i risultati migliori. Siamo convinti che una squadra di lavoro diversificata e una cultura integrativa ci permettano di sfruttare al meglio le nostre potenzialità.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Emil Frey Group The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family-owned company with 100 years of experience but also one of the leading companies in the automotive sector. Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the company's pillars. The activities focus on importing automotive brands, operating garages, logistics for spare parts and accessories, as well as providing financial services. With 19 global brands under one roof, Emil Frey AG Autocenter Safenwil offers the widest range of brands in the heart of Switzerland. Description - Diagnosis and repair of electronic, mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic vehicle systems - Execution of complex repairs, conversions, and replacements - Performance of service and maintenance work - Preparation of MFK - Technical preparation of new and used vehicles - Installation of accessories - Practical training for automotive technology students
• Requirements - Successfully completed degree as an automotive mechanic/mechatronics engineer - Ongoing or already completed degree as an automotive diagnostic technician - Independent and meticulous work - Efficient and structured approach - Responsible, team-oriented, and communicative personality - Native German speaker or very good German language skills in speaking and writing What We Offer - You will find a new challenge with interesting tasks and much more: - Numerous benefits (new and used vehicles, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels, and much more) - An attractive, independent pension fund - A long-term employment prospect - Opportunities for individual training and development - At least 25 days of vacation - Free parking - Personal restaurant Contact Melanie Achini, Local HR Manager, will be pleased to receive your complete application (e.g., resume, work certificates, etc.) via the "Apply now!" link. For readability reasons, we have decided not to use masculine, feminine, and diverse grammatical forms (m/w/d) simultaneously. Female and other gender identities are explicitly included. Diversity means that people work in teams that achieve the best results thanks to their uniqueness and diversity. We are convinced that a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture enable us to fully exploit our potential.

descriptionByLocale.en:
What you should know about us The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family-owned company with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the pillars of the company. The focus of the activities is on the import of automotive brands, the operation of garages, logistics of spare and accessory parts, as well as the provision of financial services. The Emil Frey AG, Winterthur, is the official sales and service partner of the brands Toyota, Kia, Opel, Suzuki, Lepamotor, Mitsubishi, Subaru, Jaguar, and Land Rover and has a body shop and a spare parts warehouse. Your responsibilities
• Successfully sell new and used vehicles
• Provide comprehensive customer care from the first contact to the delivery of the vehicle, including competent advice on model selection, as well as financing and insurance solutions
• Ensure professional after-sales care with the goal of long-term customer satisfaction
• Care and continuous development of the existing customer base, as well as active acquisition of new customers
• Participate in events and exhibitions Your profile
• Completed education, preferably in the automotive industry, with a commercial education or a commercial basic education
• Customer and service-oriented personality with strong communication skills, as well as a confident and convincing appearance
• You share our passion for the automotive industry and have the necessary technical knowledge
• Secure written and spoken German, other foreign languages are an advantage
• Category B driving license What we offer You will find with us a new challenge with interesting tasks and much more:
• Numerous benefits (new and used vehicles, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels, and much more)
• Your own attractive pension fund as an independent pension institution
• A long-term company perspective
• Individual training and development opportunities
• At least 25 days of vacation How to contact us Dominik Egli, Administration Manager, looks forward to your complete application (e.g. curriculum vitae, work certificates, etc.) via the link "Apply now!". For reasons of better readability, we have decided not to use the forms of address masculine, feminine, and diverse (m/w/d) simultaneously. Female and other gender identities are explicitly included. Diversity means that people work in teams that, through their uniqueness and diversity, achieve the best possible results. We are convinced that a diverse workforce and an integrative culture enable us to fully exploit our potential.

What you should know about us The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family-owned company with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the pillars of the company. The activities focus on the import of automotive brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare and accessory parts, as well as the provision of financial services. The Emil Frey AG, Züri-Oberland Wetzikon is the official sales and service partner of the exclusive brands BMW and MINI and aims to create fascination and joy of driving. Your tasks
• Execution of diagnostic, repair, and maintenance work on vehicles of the BMW & MINI brands
• Analysis and resolution of technical and electronic faults with the help of modern diagnostic systems
• Active participation in daily business
• Ensuring compliance with quality and safety standards
• Regular participation in brand-specific training and courses Your profile
• Completed vocational training as an automotive mechatronics technician EFZ and training as an automotive diagnostician or currently in training
• Maturity in the field of vehicle diagnosis
• Analytical, structured, and solution-oriented working style
• High level of responsibility, reliability, commitment, and determination
• Passion for the automotive industry and willingness to continuously learn new technologies
• Good knowledge of the German language, additional languages a plus
• Flexibility, resilience, and sense of duty
• Category B driving license What we offer
• Numerous benefits (new and used vehicles, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels, and much more)
• Our own, attractive pension fund as an independent pension fund
• A long-term perspective for the company
• Individual training and development opportunities
• At least 25 days of vacation Chiara Staccioli, Regional Personnel Manager, looks forward to receiving your complete application (e.g. resume, work certificates, etc.) via the link "Apply now!". For better readability, we have decided not to use the grammatical forms masculine, feminine, and diverse (m/w/d). Female and other gender identities are explicitly included. Diversity means that people work in teams that, due to their uniqueness and diversity, achieve the best results. We are convinced that a diverse team and an integrative culture enable us to exploit our full potential.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Cosa dovresti sapere su di noi La Gruppo Emil Frey non è solo un'azienda familiare svizzera con 100 anni di esperienza, ma anche una delle principali aziende del settore automobilistico. Qualità, tradizione, innovazione e orientamento al cliente sono i pilastri dell'azienda. In questo modo, l'attenzione delle attività è rivolta all'importazione di marche automobilistiche, all'esercizio di garage, alla logistica di pezzi di ricambio e accessori, nonché alla prestazione di servizi finanziari. L'autofficina di Zürich-Altstetten - con il suo sito al centro della Gruppo Emil Frey - presenta le gamma di modelli di sei marche mondiali, nonché una vasta scelta di occasioni. Inoltre, l'azienda comprende anche le officine di marca, un reparto di carrozzeria e un magazzino di pezzi di ricambio. Il nostro piccolo team di disposizione dei veicoli cerca immediatamente o dopo accordo un Team Leader/essa Disposizione Veicoli. Le tue responsabilità
• Fornire la leadership alla disposizione dei veicoli e garantire un funzionamento senza intoppi del giorno lavorativo
• Organizzare, gestire e continuare a ottimizzare i processi di disposizione in collaborazione con le sezioni interne e i partner esterni
• Gestire autonomamente tutta la disposizione dei veicoli nuovi (ordine, controllo dei termini, coordinamento fino all'invio)
• Coordinare e comunicare con gli importatori, i fornitori e i servizi di trasporto
• Controllare i contratti di acquisto e leasing, nonché fatturare i veicoli dei clienti e dei concessionari
• Curare e gestire i dati dei veicoli e dei clienti nei sistemi pertinenti, inclusa l'iscrizione nel portale di vendita
• Assicurarsi che i documenti dei veicoli siano disponibili, partecipare alle inventarie e supportare il capo dell'amministrazione (sostituzione) Il tuo profilo
• Laurea in economia, preferibilmente nel settore automobilistico
• Esperienza plurennale nella disposizione dei veicoli
• Prima esperienza di leadership o interesse marcato per una funzione di leadership
• Deutsch scritto e parlato con sicurezza, ulteriori lingue utili
• Stile di lavoro strutturato, autonomo e orientato alle soluzioni
• Alta disponibilità, senso di responsabilità e talento organizzativo
• Personalità orientata al team con capacità di imporsi Cosa ti offriamo
• Troverai una nuova sfida con compiti affascinanti e molto altro:
• Numerose agevolazioni (nuovi e usati, lavori di servizio e pezzi di ricambio, assicurazioni dei veicoli e malattia, carte di carburante, alberghi e molto altro)
• Una pensione propria, attrattiva, come ente di previdenza indipendente
• Una prospettiva di impiego a lungo termine
• Possibilità di sviluppo e formazione individuali
• Minimo 25 giorni di ferie
• Ristorante personale Come contattarci Siamo felici di ricevere la tua candidatura completa (ad esempio, curriculum, attestati di lavoro, ecc.) via il link 'Candida ora!' Per motivi di leggibilità, si è deciso di non utilizzare contemporaneamente le forme grammaticali maschile, femminile e diverso (m/w/d). Le donne e le altre identità di genere sono esplicitamente incluse. La diversità significa per noi che le persone lavorano insieme in team che, grazie alla loro unicità e diversità, raggiungono i risultati migliori. Siamo convinti che un'ampia gamma di personale, nonché una cultura integrativa, ci consentano di sfruttare al meglio le nostre potenzialità.
descriptionByLocale.en:
What you should know about us The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family-owned company with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the pillars of the company. The focus of the activities is on the import of automotive brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare and accessory parts, as well as the provision of financial services. The Zurich-Altstetten car dealership - with its location at the headquarters of the Emil Frey Group - presents the model ranges of six world brands, as well as a large selection of used cars. The company also includes the brand workshops, a bodywork department, and a spare parts warehouse. Our small team of vehicle disposition is looking for a Team Leader/Vehicle Disposition immediately or by agreement. Your tasks
• Leading the vehicle disposition and ensuring a smooth daily operation
• Organizing, managing, and continuously optimizing the disposition processes in collaboration with internal departments and external partners
• Independently handling the entire new vehicle disposition (ordering, term monitoring, coordination until delivery)
• Coordinating and communicating with importers, suppliers, and transportation services
• Controlling purchase and leasing contracts, as well as invoicing customer and dealer vehicles
• Maintaining and managing vehicle and customer data in relevant systems, including registration in the sales portal
• Ensuring vehicle documents are available, participating in inventories, and supporting the Administration Manager (deputy) Your profile
• Completed commercial education, ideally in the automotive industry
• Several years of experience in vehicle disposition
• First leadership experience or strong interest in a leadership function
• Fluent German in writing and speaking, additional languages an asset
• Structured, independent, and solution-oriented working style
• High commitment, sense of responsibility, and organizational talent
• Team-oriented personality with assertiveness What we offer you
• You will find a new challenge with exciting tasks and much more:
• Numerous benefits (new and used cars, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels, and much more)
• A private, attractive pension fund as an independent pension fund
• A long-term company perspective
• Individual development and training opportunities
• At least 25 days of vacation
• Personal restaurant How to contact us We look forward to receiving your complete application (e.g., resume, work certificates, etc.) via the link 'Apply now!' For better readability, we have decided not to use the grammatical forms male, female, and diverse (m/w/d) simultaneously. Women and other gender identities are explicitly included. Diversity means to us that people work together in teams that, due to their uniqueness and diversity, achieve the best results. We are convinced that a diverse workforce, as well as an integrative culture, enable us to fully exploit our potential.

L'entreprise comprend également les ateliers de marques, un département de carrosserie et un entrepôt de pièces de rechange. • Un fonds de pension privé, attractif, en tant qu'entité de prévoyance indépendante

Nous sommes convaincus que un personnel diversifié, ainsi qu'une culture intégrative, nous permettent de pleinement exploiter notre potentiel.

What you should know about us The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family-owned company with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the pillars of the company. The focus of the activities is on the import of car brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare parts and accessories, as well as the provision of financial services. The Emil Frey AG Biel is the official sales and/or service partner of the brands Subaru, Jaguar / Land Rover, Toyota, Kia, and Suzuki. We are looking for reinforcement for our team in Biel as of May 1, 2026 or by agreement. Your tasks
• You take care of the success-oriented and active sales of our broad model palette
• From the first contact, you care for our customers, advise them on the vehicle selection and the various financing and insurance options
• You ensure the successful delivery of the vehicle and the follow-up contact (especially customer satisfaction)
• The daily care of your existing customer base and the acquisition of new customers are part of your tasks, as well as the management and care of the vehicle park
• The care of our online appearance of the vehicles (announcement, photos, etc.)
• The help with events/exhibitions and the close cooperation with our departments (workshop, spare parts warehouse and customer service) is assumed Your profile
• Sales and consulting are fun for you
• You are a sales-oriented and strong negotiating personality and have already gained experience in sales and in the automotive industry (advantage)
• Your commercial flair, your customer and service orientation, and your communicative strength characterize you
• A high level of personal motivation, assertiveness, and passion for cars complete your profile
• You are fascinated by new technologies, trends, and IT and have a high level of flexibility and willingness to learn
• You speak at least two languages (DE and FR) and hold a category B driving license
• Your positive attitude enables you to easily integrate into a motivated and open team What we offer you
• You will find a new challenge with exciting tasks and much more:
• Numerous benefits (new and used cars, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels, and much more)
• Your own attractive pension fund as an independent pension fund
• A long-term corporate perspective
• Individual training and development opportunities

descriptionByLocale.en:
Join our HR team and help shape the future of Emil Frey Mobility! The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family-owned company with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the pillars of the company. Our activities focus on the import of car brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare and accessory parts, as well as the provision of financial services. At Emil Frey Mobility, we rely on a trusting and respectful collaboration. As an HR Generalist (100%), you will play an important role in shaping our HR processes and supporting our team with your expertise. If you appreciate a dynamic work environment and work with a positive and proactive attitude, you're in the right place! Here's what you can expect:
• You are the first point of contact for all administrative HR matters and support the team in all processes.
• You help with the coordination and execution of recruitment activities, from the publication of the announcement to the preparation of the interview with superiors and the drafting of the contract.
• You bring your affinity for numbers and support in preparing and processing the monthly payroll.
• From creating certificates of employment to other personal documents - you always keep track.
• You have successfully completed a commercial training and have already gained experience in HR administration. A training as HR Assistant is desired.
• Your German flows smoothly, you have a good level of English and bring good French skills, so you can also support and recruit our employees in the Romandie region.
• You feel comfortable with numbers.
• As an open personality, you work well in teams and with a positive attitude, you contribute to our success as a team.
• You are willing to go the extra mile, feel driven by changes and with your excellent administrative and multitasking skills, you can dance on different occasions without losing track. Why Emil Frey Mobility AG? In addition to our exceptional team, our passion for innovation, and the opportunity to contribute to the future growth of Emil Frey Mobility AG, we offer other benefits:
• Numerous discounts (new and used cars, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels, and much more)
• Our own, attractive pension fund as an independent pension fund
• A long-term perspective for the company
• Individual training and development opportunities
• At least 25 days of vacation If you feel involved in this position and want to become part of our committed HR team, we would be happy to get to know you better! Let's work together on the future of Emil Frey Mobility. We are looking forward to receiving your application! How you can contact us Michelle Salina, HR Generalist, looks forward to receiving the complete application (e.g., curriculum, certificates of employment, etc.) via the link 'Apply now!'. For reasons of readability, we have decided not to use the grammatical forms male, female, and diverse (m/w/d) simultaneously. Women and other gender identities are explicitly included. Diversity means that people work in teams that, due to their uniqueness and diversity, achieve the best results. We are convinced that a multilingual and integrative culture enables us to tap into our full potential.
• You are willing to go the extra mile and feel driven by changes and with your excellent administrative and multitasking skills, you can dance on different occasions without losing track.

• Notre propre, attractive caisse de pension en tant qu'entité de pension indépendante
• Une perspective à long terme pour l'entreprise
• Des possibilités de formation et de développement individuels

What you should know about us The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family company with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation and customer orientation are the main pillars of the company. The focus of the activities is on the import of car brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare and accessories as well as the provision of financial services. The Zurich-Altstetten dealership – with its location at the headquarters of the Emil Frey Group – presents the model palettes of seven global brands as well as a large selection of occasions. The company also includes the brand workshops, a carrosserie department and a spare parts warehouse. Your tasks
• Repair and maintenance of vehicles according to the manufacturer’s specifications
• Check the functionality of various components
• Diagnosis with the help of the workshop manager
• Interpret and apply technical documents, schemes and schematics
• Installation of accessories
• Own quality control after completion of work
• Regular participation in brand-specific further education Your profile
• Completed vocational apprenticeship as an automotive specialist or mechatronics specialist
• Brand experience of advantage
• Professionally versed and up-to-date with the latest state of mechanics, technology, electronics and diagnostics
• Independent, solution-oriented and careful working methods
• Resilient, committed as well as team-oriented
• Customer-oriented and high willingness to provide services
• Good knowledge of German What we offer you You will find a new challenge with exciting tasks and much more:
• Numerous discounts (new and used cars, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels and much more)
• An own, attractive pension fund as an independent pension institution
• A long-term company perspective
• Individual training and development opportunities
• At least 25 days of holidays
• A staff restaurant on site How to contact us We look forward to the complete application (e.g. CV, employment certificates, etc.) via the link "Apply now!". For reasons of better legibility, the simultaneous use of the language forms male, female and diverse (m/f/d) is omitted. Female and other gender identities are explicitly included. Diversity also means for us that people work together in teams that achieve the best possible results through their uniqueness and diversity. We believe that a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture enable us to realize our full potential.

jobs.description:
Was Du über uns wissen solltest Die Emil Frey Gruppe ist nicht nur ein Schweizer Familienunternehmen mit über 100 Jahren Erfahrung, sondern auch eine der führenden Firmen der Automobilbranche. Qualität, Tradition, Innovation und Kundenorientierung sind die tragenden Pfeiler des Unternehmens. Dabei liegt der Fokus der Aktivitäten auf dem Import von Automarken, dem Betrieb von Garagen, der Logistik von Ersatz- und Zubehörteilen sowie der Erbringung von Finanzdienstleistungen. Die Emil Frey Mobility AG ist ein Kompetenz-Zentrum für integrierte Mobilitäts-Dienstleistungen rund um's Auto. Dazu gehören Fahrzeugversicherungen, aber auch unsere eigenen Finanzierungsgesellschaften. Darauf kannst du dich freuen: Du hast ein Auge fürs Detail, denkst risikobewusst und schätzt Verantwortung? Dann gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Mobilitätsfinanzierung! Bei uns erwartet dich eine spannende Position mit Wirkung: Du prüfst nicht einfach Anträge, du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Leasinggeschäfte sicher, effizient und kundenorientiert abgewickelt werden.
• Prüfung von Leasinganträgen auf Vollständigkeit, Plausibilität und Qualität
• Durchführung gesetzeskonformer Bonitäts- und Risikoanalysen (GWG, KKG)
• Bearbeitung von Vertragsänderungen wie Umschreibungen und Verlängerungen
• Telefonische & schriftliche Beratung von Händlern, Partnern und Endkunden
• Unterstützung des Aussendienstes bei der Umsetzung unserer Vertriebsstrategie Das bringst du mit:
• Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung. Idealerweise mit Erfahrung im Finanz- oder Mobilitätsbereich.
• Du bringst Berufserfahrung in der Antragsprüfung oder im Leasing-/Kreditwesen mit.
• Gesetzliche Vorgaben wie das GWG und KKG sind dir vertraut und du kannst Bonitäten einschätzen.
• Der Umgang mit Vertragsunterlagen sowie digitalen CRM- und Finanzierungssystemen fällt dir leicht.
• Du arbeitest strukturiert, denkst analytisch und behältst auch unter Zeitdruck den Überblick.
• Du kommunizierst klar und professionell. Auf Deutsch stilsicher, auf Französisch sehr gut, Italienisch ist ein Plus.
• Du bist kundenorientiert, teamfähig und bringst die Bereitschaft mit, dich laufend fachlich weiterzuentwickeln. Was wir Dir bieten Nebst der Möglichkeit die Zukunft der Mobilität mitzugestalten und Autoträume zu verwirklichen bieten wir weitere Benefits:
• Als familiengeführtes Unternehmen legen wir Wert auf langfristige Beziehungen und nachhaltiges Wachstum.
• Die Chance, den Ausbau und die Ausrichtung von Emil Frey Mobility AG mit deinen Ideen aktiv mitzugestalten.
• Bei uns erwartet dich eine positive Arbeitsumgebung, die auf Teamgeist und Respekt basiert.
• Zahlreiche Vergünstigungen (Neu- und Gebrauchtwagen, Servicearbeiten und Ersatzteile, Fahrzeug- und Krankenversicherungen, Tankkarten, Hotels und vieles mehr)
• Eine eigene, attraktive Pensionskasse als unabhängige Vorsorgeeinrichtung
• Wir investieren in deine Weiterbildung und bieten dir zahlreiche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Wie Du uns kontaktieren kannst Michelle Salina, Mitarbeiterin Personal freut sich auf die vollständige Bewerbung (u.a. Lebenslauf, Arbeitszeugnisse, etc.) via des Links "Jetzt bewerben!". Aus Gründen der besseren Lesbarkeit wird auf die gleichzeitige Verwendung der Sprachformen männlich, weiblich und divers (m/w/d) verzichtet. Weibliche und anderweitige Geschlechteridentitäten werden dabei ausdrücklich mitgemeint. Qualità, tradizione, innovazione e orientamento al cliente sono i principali pilastri dell'azienda. Il focus delle attività è sull'importazione di marchi di auto, il funzionamento di garage, la logistica di ricambio e accessori, nonché la fornitura di servizi finanziari. La concessionaria Zurigo-Altstetten – con la sua sede presso la sede del Gruppo Emil Frey – presenta le palette dei modelli di sei marchi mondiali e una vasta gamma di occasioni. L'azienda comprende anche i laboratori di marca, un reparto carosserie e un magazzino di pezzi di ricambio.
• Gestione della linea di lavanderia
• Cura, pulizia e manutenzione della linea di lavanderia

• Trasferimenti del veicolo
• Assistenza nella preparazione del veicolo durante i colli di bottiglia del personale nella nuova preparazione dell'auto Il vostro profilo
• Personalità amichevole, flessibile e affidabile con metodi di lavoro indipendenti e approfonditi

• Buone competenze tedesche orali Quello che vi offriamo Troverete una nuova sfida con compiti entusiasmanti e molto altro:
• Numerosi sconti (auto nuove e usate, lavoro di servizio e ricambi, assicurazione veicolo e sanitaria, carte di carburante, hotel e molto altro ancora)
• Un proprio, attraente fondo pensionistico come istituzione pensione indipendente

descriptionByLocale.en:
What you should know about us The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family company with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation and customer orientation are the main pillars of the company. The focus of the activities is on the import of car brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare and accessories as well as the provision of financial services. The Zurich-Altstetten dealership – with its location at the headquarters of the Emil Frey Group – presents the model palettes of six world brands as well as a wide range of occasions. The company also includes the brand workshops, a carrosserie department and a spare parts warehouse. Your tasks
• Operation of the laundry line
• Care, cleaning and maintenance of the laundry line
• Manual pre- and interior cleaning of customer vehicles and demonstration vehicles
• Vehicle transfers
• Assistance in the vehicle preparation during personnel bottlenecks in the new car preparation Your profile
• Friendly, flexible and reliable personality with independent and thorough working methods
• High quality and sense of responsibility – You are jointly responsible for the appearance of our vehicles
• Good physical condition
• Safe and experienced driver (valid driving licence Cat. B)
• Good oral German skills What we offer you You will find a new challenge with exciting tasks and much more:
• Numerous discounts (new and used cars, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels and much more)
• An own, attractive pension fund as an independent pension institution
• A long-term company perspective
• Individual training and development opportunities
• At least 25 days of holiday
• Own staff restaurant As you can contact us We look forward to the complete application (e.g. CV, employment certificates, etc.) via the link "Apply now!". For reasons of better legibility, the simultaneous use of the language forms male, female and diverse (m/f/d) is omitted. Female and other gender identities are explicitly included. Diversity also means for us that people work together in teams that achieve the best possible results through their uniqueness and diversity. We believe that a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture enable us to realize our full potential.
• Operation of the car wash line
• Maintenance, cleaning and maintenance of the car wash line
• Manual pre- and interior cleaning of customer vehicles and demonstration vehicles
• Vehicle transfers
• Assistance in the vehicle preparation during personnel bottlenecks in the new car preparation
• Friendly, flexible and reliable personality with independent and thorough working methods
• High quality and sense of responsibility – You are jointly responsible for the appearance of our vehicles
• Good physical condition
• Safe and experienced driver (valid driving licence Cat. B)
• Good oral German skills
descriptionByLocale.de:
Was Sie über uns wissen sollten Die Emil Frey Gruppe ist nicht nur ein Schweizer Familienunternehmen mit 100 Jahren Erfahrung, sondern auch eine der führenden Firmen der Automobilbranche. Qualität, Tradition, Innovation und Kundenorientierung sind die tragenden Pfeiler des Unternehmens. Dabei liegt der Fokus der Aktivitäten auf dem Import von Automarken, dem Betrieb von Garagen, der Logistik von Ersatz- und Zubehörteilen sowie der Erbringung von Finanzdienstleistungen. Das Autohaus Zürich-Altstetten – mit seinem Standort am Hauptsitz der Emil Frey Gruppe – präsentiert die Modellpaletten von sechs Weltmarken sowie eine grosse Auswahl an Occasionen. Zum Betrieb gehören weiter die Markenwerkstätten, eine Carrosserieabteilung sowie ein Ersatzteillager. Ihre Aufgaben
• Bedienung der Waschstrasse
• Pflege, Reinigung und Unterhalt der Waschstrasse
• Manuelle Vor- und Innenreinigung der Kundenfahrzeuge und Vorführwagen
• Fahrzeugüberführungen
• Mithilfe bei der Fahrzeugaufbereitung während personellen Engpässen in der Neuwagenaufbereitung Ihr Profil
• Freundliche, flexible und zuverlässige Persönlichkeit mit selbstständiger und gründlicher Arbeitsweise
• Hohes Qualitäts- und Verantwortungsbewusstsein – Sie sind mitverantwortlich für das Erscheinungsbild unserer Fahrzeuge
• Gute körperliche Verfassung
• Sicherer und routinierter Autofahrer (gültiger Führerausweis Kat. B)
• Gute mündliche Deutschkenntnisse Was wir Ihnen bieten Sie finden bei uns eine neue Herausforderung mit spannenden Aufgaben und vielem mehr:
• Zahlreiche Vergünstigungen (Neu- und Gebrauchtwagen, Servicearbeiten und Ersatzteile, Fahrzeug- und Krankenversicherungen, Tankkarten, Hotels und vieles mehr)
• Eine eigene, attraktive Pensionskasse als unabhängige Vorsorgeeinrichtung
• Eine langfristige Unternehmensperspektive
• Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungs-Möglichkeiten
• Mindestens 25 Tage Ferien
• Eigenes Personalrestaurant Wie Sie uns kontaktieren können Wir freuen uns auf die vollständige Bewerbung (u.a. Lebenslauf, Arbeitszeugnisse, etc.) via des Links "Jetzt bewerben!". Aus Gründen der besseren Lesbarkeit wird auf die gleichzeitige Verwendung der Sprachformen männlich, weiblich und divers (m/w/d) verzichtet. Weibliche und anderweitige Geschlechteridentitäten werden dabei ausdrücklich mitgemeint. Diversität bedeutet für uns auch, dass Menschen in Teams zusammenarbeiten, die durch ihre Einzigartigkeit und Unterschiedlichkeit die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse erzielen. Wir sind davon überzeugt, dass eine vielfältige Belegschaft, sowie eine integrative Kultur es uns ermöglichen, unser volles Potenzial auszuschöpfen.

jobs.description:
Du bist kommunikativ, organisiert und hast ein Händchen für Zahlen? Dann werde Teil der Emil Frey Mobility AG, dem starken Partner für integrierte Mobilitätsdienstleistungen. Im Bereich Inkasso sorgst du dafür, dass unsere Leasing-Kunden entspannt mobil bleiben können. Mit deiner Arbeit hältst du die Prozesse am Laufen und gestaltest so aktiv die Zukunft der Mobilität mit. Die Emil Frey Gruppe ist nicht nur ein Schweizer Familienunternehmen mit 100 Jahren Erfahrung, sondern auch eine der führenden Firmen der Automobilbranche. Qualität, Tradition, Innovation und Kundenorientierung sind die tragenden Pfeiler des Unternehmens. Dabei liegt der Fokus der Aktivitäten auf dem Import von Automarken, dem Betrieb von Garagen, der Logistik von Ersatz- und Zubehörteilen sowie der Erbringung von Finanzdienstleistungen. • Die Kommunikation mit Kunden, Händlern und Behörden liegt in deiner Hand - am Telefon und schriftlich.
• Zahlungseingänge beobachtest du genau und findest Lösungen bei offenen Posten.

• Du hast eine kaufmännische Ausbildung abgeschlossen und hattest schon mal Berührungspunkte mit dem Finanzwesen.

• Microsoft 365 ist für dich keine Blackbox.
• Deutsch beherrscht du sicher, eine weitere Sprache (Französisch oder Italienisch) bringst du ebenfalls mit und sprichst sie fliessend.
• Du bist organisiert, lernbereit und packst gerne mit an. Was wir Dir bieten Du findest bei uns eine neue Herausforderung mit spannenden Aufgaben und vielem mehr:
• Zahlreiche Vergünstigungen (Neu- und Gebrauchtwagen, Servicearbeiten und Ersatzteile, Fahrzeug- und Krankenversicherungen, Tankkarten, Hotels und vieles mehr)
• Eine eigene, attraktive Pensionskasse als unabhängige Vorsorgeeinrichtung
• Eine langfristige Unternehmensperspektive
• Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungs-Möglichkeiten
• Mindestens 25 Tage Ferien Wie Du uns kontaktieren kannst Michelle Salina, HR Generliastin freut sich auf die vollständige Bewerbung (u.a. Lebenslauf, Arbeitszeugnisse, etc.) via des Links "Jetzt bewerben!". Aus Gründen der besseren Lesbarkeit wird auf die gleichzeitige Verwendung der Sprachformen männlich, weiblich und divers (m/w/d) verzichtet. Weibliche und anderweitige Geschlechteridentitäten werden dabei ausdrücklich mitgemeint.
